title: Number of Provinces
summary: Given an n x n matrix isConnected where isConnected[i][j] equals 1 if the i-th city is directly connected to the j-th city, and 0 otherwise, determine the total number of provinces.
statement: Given an n x n matrix isConnected where isConnected[i][j] equals 1 if the i-th city is directly connected to the j-th city, and 0 otherwise, determine the total number of provinces. A province is defined as a group of cities that are directly or indirectly connected to each other.
constraints: is_connected is symmetric and its diagonal entries are one.
hints: A province is a connected component.
Explore all reachable cities once, then begin another component only when needed.
For each unvisited city, increment count and DFS through connected neighbors.
The outer loop starts precisely once per connected component.
editorial: The outer loop starts precisely once per connected component.

tests.explanation: Cities 0 and 1 form one connected component; city 2 forms another.
No city connects to another, so each city is its own province.
